title: HamAlert trigger settings
description: Editable settings for hamalert-cli add-trigger and edit.

conditions.description: Spot filters. Add at least one condition before saving.

callsign.description: Match one or more callsigns without prefixes or suffixes.

band.description: Bands to match, such as 20m or 40m.

mode.description: Modes to match, such as cw or ft8.

source.description: Spot sources to match, such as pskreporter.

snrTo.description: Maximum SNR in dB. Omit to use the default maximum.

actions.description: Notification actions, such as app, telnet, threema, or url.

options.description: Optional settings such as Club Log configuration.
